text: The timeline is everything that suffers.
The world, for present purposes, is the world as refracted through a quote-post.
What can be said at all can be said in three hundred graphemes. What cannot be said in three hundred graphemes will be said in a forty-post thread instead.
A blueskyism is a form of suffering with a reply button attached.
The Ontological Escalation: a private grievance, formalized into linked logical atoms before its author has finished being sad about it.
Named propositions. Numbered sub-propositions. A diagram, on the worse days.
It cites Wittgenstein. It always cites Wittgenstein.
The Well-Actually: arrives within four minutes, and corrects a fact adjacent to, but not load-bearing for, your point.
The Quote-Skeet Dunk: your words, recontextualized for an audience that will never once see your reply.
The ratio you cannot refute, because you cannot see it.
The "as a ___, I" preface: credentials presented before the take, so the take can be argued with as a person instead of as an idea.
The Concern Troll: questions the asker already has answers to, asked as though they don't.
The Main Character Wind: you become main character by posting; you become main character by not posting. There is no heading in which you remain a minor character.
The screenshot without context, four quote-posts deep from the thing it was originally about.
The Discourse Cycle: the same argument, one week later, wearing a new cast.
Nobody present remembers the last cycle. Everybody present is certain this time is different.
Whereof one cannot skeet, thereof one must screenshot and post to a different app instead.
The "I'm leaving this app" post. It does not leave the app.
